create_visual_encoder_with_resnet: create a VisualEncoder with a ResNet backbone config and default 128x128 image size
create_visual_encoder_with_vit: create a VisualEncoder with a ViT or BEiT backbone config and global pooling enabled
run_visual_encoder_forward: run the VisualEncoder forward pass on a torch tensor to get compressed visual features
get_loaded_backbone_data: get the backbone model, embedding dimension, and visual transform from an existing VisualEncoder instance
review_visual_encoder_init: review the VisualEncoder init to understand ResNet vs ViT backbone branching and compression layer setup
